raw.description:
Sobre Tenpo

¡En Tenpo estamos construyendo el futuro de las finanzas en Chile!

Hoy somos más de 400 profesionales unidos por un hito histórico: somos el primer Neobanco del país. Hemos evolucionado para crear un ecosistema financiero 100% digital, sólido e inclusivo, diseñado para derribar las barreras de la banca tradicional y ser accesible para todas las personas.

Dejamos de ser solo una app para convertirnos en la propuesta bancaria más innovadora de Chile. Aquí nos mueve la pasión por la excelencia y el propósito claro de transformar la industria con tecnología de punta y visión de futuro.

En Tenpo somos líderes, somos valientes ante los desafíos y, sobre todo, somos humanos: conectamos de verdad con las necesidades de las personas y de nuestro país.

El futuro ya llegó y tiene licencia bancaria. Vamos con todo. Con fuerza. Con visión.

Con N de Neobanco. #TenpoConNdeNeobanco 💚

Sobre el Cargo

Apoyar la gestión, monitoreo y reporte de incidentes tecnológicos, y operacionales, contribuir al desarrollo y mejora continua del Sistema de Gestión de Continuidad del Negocio (SGCN), asegurando la alineación con las normativas de la CMF y la disponibilidad de los procesos críticos de Tenpo ante situaciones de crisis o interrupción.

Responsabilidades del cargo

1.Gestión y atención de incidentes tecnológicos y operacionalesApoyar la gestión del incidente, coordinar equipos resolutores, registro, análisis, reporte de incidentes operacionales, asegurando la trazabilidad completa del evento y la comunicación oportuna al ente regulador cuando corresponda.

2.Mantenimiento del SGCN

Implementar y actualizar el Sistema de Gestión de Continuidad del Negocio, asegurando su alineación con las normas y regulaciones aplicables (CMF, ISO 22301).

3.Análisis de impacto al negocio (BIA) y análisis de riesgos (RIA)Definición e implementación del análisis de impacto al negocio (BIA) y el análisis de riesgos de interrupción (RIA), identificando los procesos críticos y sus dependencias.

4.Planes de Continuidad del Negocio (BCP)Desarrollar, mantener y actualizar los Planes de Continuidad del Negocio, asegurando que estén vigentes, validados y disponibles para su activación ante una contingencia.

5.Planes de Recuperación ante Desastres (DRP)Apoyar la elaboración y mantenimiento de los planes de recuperación ante desastres, coordinando con las áreas de Tecnología y Operaciones para asegurar su viabilidad técnica.

6.Pruebas y simulacros de continuidadPlanificar, coordinar y ejecutar pruebas periódicas de continuidad (simulacros de crisis, recuperación ante desastres, failover), documentando resultados y liderando acciones de mejora.

7.Capacitación y cultura de continuidadDiseñar y realizar capacitaciones sobre los planes de continuidad del negocio para las áreas críticas, promoviendo una cultura de preparación y respuesta ante contingencias.

8.Actividades de la Gerencia
Apoyar en las tareas de asignación internas dentro del equipo.


¿Qué necesitas para postular?

Formación académica

Título profesional en Ingeniería en Informática, Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Comercial, Auditoría o carreras afines.

Experiencia

Se requiere entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia en roles vinculados a riesgo operacional, continuidad del negocio o gestión de incidentes, idealmente en instituciones financieras, fintech o empresas de base tecnológica.

Experiencia excluyente:

Haber participado activamente en al menos dos de las siguientes actividades:

  • Gestión de incidentes bajo marcos como ITIL, incluyendo clasificación, escalamiento y seguimiento hasta el cierre.

  • Elaboración, actualización o ejecución de planes de continuidad del negocio (BCP) o recuperación ante desastres (DRP).

  • Preparación de reportes de riesgo operacional para comités internos o entidades reguladoras.

  • Gestión de crisis operativas en entornos digitales o de alta disponibilidad.

Experiencia deseable:

  • Trayectoria en industrias con alta exigencia regulatoria (banca, seguros, fintech).

  • Participación en simulacros o pruebas de continuidad operativa.

Visión de negocio esperada: Comprensión de cómo la gestión efectiva de incidentes y la continuidad operativa sostienen la confianza regulatoria y la reputación de un neobanco, donde una interrupción puede impactar a miles de personas en tiempo real.

Conocimientos técnicos

Excluyentes:

  • Dominio de los pilares de continuidad del negocio: BCP, DRP, BIA y RIA (diseño, ejecución y mantenimiento).

  • Conocimiento de la normativa CMF aplicable a continuidad operativa y gestión de incidentes en la industria financiera chilena.

  • SQL básico para consulta y extracción de datos.

Deseables:

  • Manejo de herramientas de monitoreo, alertamiento y gestión de incidentes (por ejemplo, Jira Service Management, PagerDuty, Datadog u Opsgenie).

  • Conocimiento del marco ITIL v4, en particular los módulos de gestión de incidentes y gestión de problemas.

  • Familiaridad con marcos de gestión de riesgo operacional (COSO, Basilea II/III).

Certificaciones deseables

  • ISO 22301 — Lead Implementer o Lead Auditor.

  • ITIL Foundation v4.

  • Certificación en gestión de riesgo operacional (COSO o Basilea).

  • Diplomado en Continuidad del Negocio o Gestión de Crisis.



Beneficios de Trabajar en Tenpo

📚 Presupuesto anual para autogestionar capacitación.

👩‍💻 Teletrabajo.

🎂 Día del cumpleaños libre.

🧁 Medio día cumpleaños hij@s/padres.

💃 Viernes cortos (todos los viernes terminamos a las 14 horas).

🌍 Work from anywhere (¡Trabaja desde donde quieras! Solo recuerda tener una buena conexión a internet).

✨ Entre muchos otros!!!

En Tenpo valoramos la diversidad y promovemos un entorno inclusivo y seguro para todas las personas, independientemente de su discapacidad, cultura, religión, etnia, género o identidad LGBTQ+.

¡Únete a nosotros y sé parte del cambio! 🚀

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead our dynamic team towards unparalleled service excellence in the healthcare sector. This role is central to our mission, bridging the gap between our innovative RTLS solutions and the customers we serve. You will be at the helm of a dedicated team of Solutions Specialists, ensuring our technology not only meets but exceeds our clients' expectations. Your role is multifaceted, involving direct engagement with customers, overseeing the seamless integration of our services, and fostering continuous improvement through strategic audits and solutions enhancement. Collaborating closely with the Key Account Management Team, you will ensure that our solutions are perfectly aligned with our clients' needs, driving success and satisfaction across the board.

Our Mission:

Be at the forefront of transforming healthcare with our pioneering RTLS technology. We are driven by collaboration, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Our goal is to optimize healthcare outcomes and enhance patient experiences through efficient and innovative use of technology.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Direct and oversee the Solutions Specialists team, driving the successful adoption and integration of our RTLS solutions across client sites.

  • Foster strong, collaborative relationships with the Key Account Management Team to ensure cohesive service delivery and client satisfaction.

  • Proactively support direct and indirect customer relationships with CenTrak, including aiding regional Customer Success Managers and partners in creating sustainable solutions environments.

  • Conduct continuous inspections and audits of existing and newly deployed solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Develop strategies to optimize customer account management and service delivery, leveraging our RTLS technology to its fullest potential.

  • Identify customers that can, and should, be moved to remediation status.

  • Work with customers to identify best-practices around managing system health.

  • For large Integrated Delivery Networks (IDN) or Key Accounts supervise additional CenTrak team members assigned to the account.

  • Identify issues impacting system health and coordinating necessary internal/external resources to resolve

  • Maintain regular contact with customers and partners including regularly scheduled meetings.

  • For complex issues, coordinate CenTrak internal resources (technical support, project management, Engineering, Sales, etc.), as well as partners, to help drive to resolution.

  • Ensure the highest standards of service excellence, informed by customer feedback, performance analytics, and market trends.

  • Promote a culture of innovation, excellence, and continuous improvement within your team and across CenTrak.

  • Provide or facilitate ongoing post implementation training/education.

  • Make minor modifications to end user application.

  • Mentor and manage team members to foster professional growth and excellence.

Qualifications:

  • At least 7 years of leadership experience in technology, healthcare, or customer success roles, with a clear focus on service delivery and team management.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage customer-focused teams effectively, with a strong emphasis on solution-based strategies and customer satisfaction.

  • Exceptional leadership, strategic planning, and team-building skills, coupled with the ability to engage and inspire.

  • Overnight travel up to 10-20%.

  • Effective communication skills, capable of connecting with a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptability and problem-solving aptitude in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

  • In-depth knowledge of RTLS and healthcare technology.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, technology, or a related field.

***CenTrak is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.***

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

The Opportunity:

The Sourcing Manager, Direct Materials is responsible for developing sourcing strategies, executing on sourcing initiatives, and managing sourcing activities in the Americas in his/her specific category.

This role will have commercial responsibility for a subset of material commodities, which could include: acids (acetic acid, nitric acid, sulfuric acid, hydrochloric acid), solvents (dimethyl sulfoxide, acetone, isopropyl alcohol, benzyl alcohol, methanol, dichloromethane, hexane/heptane), surfactants (Dithiothreitol, Saponin) to name a few.

Remote role - CST / EST time zone preferred

How you will thrive and create an impact

  • Accountable for roughly $50-75M spend per year

  • Works with Director, Direct Sourcing to develop and present sourcing strategies to reduce category cost and mitigate supply risk

  • Leverages market intelligence and analyses to identify opportunities and risks, including but not limited to spend analysis, commodity pricing forecasts, contract coverage analysis, etc.

  • Collaborates with product management, commercial and operations teams that direct sourcing supports to ensure alignment on sourcing strategies, and that relevant market intelligence is shared.

  • Develops and maintains a rolling 36-month sourcing strategy and project roadmap, identifying savings estimates, estimated timing of savings, and execution plans Drives execution of category sourcing strategies (e.g., RFI/RFQ, supplier qualification, auction rounds, negotiation), coordinating with Technical Managers, Quality, Product Managers, and others as required.

  • Maintains relationships with key vendors, and helps address vendor related issues (e.g., pricing issues, performance issues, etc.)

  • Monitors category spend to ensure sourcing savings are captured and do not erode over time

  • Conducts regular project execution reviews with the Director and VP, Direct Strategic Sourcing, and the respective business/functional leaders

  • Responds to raw material category sourcing requests in a timely and efficient manner

  • Negotiates contracts in line with corporate DOA guidelines

  • Supports the budget process by providing expectations for material price outlooks

What we're looking for

Education:

  • BS/BA Degree required; Degree in engineering, including chemical, or a related field preferred

  • Lean Six Sigma Certification preferred (yellow, green, or black belt)

Experience:

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of total related experience required

  • Minimum of five (5) years of related procurement, operational, or commercial experience in the chemical or pharmaceutical industries

  • Experience with matrixed global project responsibility preferred

  • SAP experience highly preferred

  • Microsoft Excel advanced skills highly preferred

Skills/Competencies:

  • Ability to lead internal cross functional meetings, external supplier business reviews

  • Strategic mindset and ability to execute hands-on

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills

  • Can-do mindset, creative, solution-focused, and action-oriented

  • Ability and track record of managing complex sourcing/procurement projects

  • Proactive spend control, spend analysis and strategy execution skills

  • Fact and analysis-based decision-maker

  • Proven contracting and contract management skills

  • Strong interpersonal relationship management skills

  • Highly organized, well structured, self-managed, clear priority management skill set

raw.description:
das kannst du von uns erwarten:

Bei uns wirst du Teil einer jungen Firma, die sich komplett auf Beratung und Dienstleistung des deutschen, öffentlichen Sektors spezialisiert hat. Mit unseren wachsenden Teams erweitern wir stetig unser Angebot in Einklang mit dem Markt und den Fokusthemen unserer Mitarbeiter.

Zum Start wirst du ein umfangreiches Onboarding durchlaufen. Neben dem laufenden 1:1-Coaching haben wir dazu einen E-Learning-Kurs aufgebaut, um dich nachhaltig in alle Aspekte des Unternehmens einzuarbeiten.

Gemeinsam finden wir heraus, auf welchen Gebieten du dich weiterentwickeln möchtest. Passende Fortbildungen und Zertifizierungen erhältst du von uns.
Für deinen Arbeitsalltag stellen wir dir eine hochwertige IT-Ausstattung zur Verfügung (inkl. iPhone auch zur privaten Nutzung).
Benefits stimmen wir individuell ab: Je nach Bedarf können wir z. B. Dienstwagen, JobRad, ÖPNV-Tickets, BahnCard, Fitness-Studio vereinbaren.

deine mission:

Du möchtest eigenverantwortlich Projekte im öffentlichen Sektor prägen - werde Consultant

Als Consultant bei public.consulting gestaltest du aktiv unsere Kundenprojekte und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung und Erfolg. Du entwickelst deine fachliche Spezialisierung und Methodensicherheit kontinuierlich weiter und bist ein wertvoller Teil unserer Beratungsteams.
Du arbeitest eigenständig im Projekt und bist in der Lage, anspruchsvolle Kundensituationen selbstständig zu lösen und proaktiv Herausforderungen anzugehen. Durch dein professionelles Auftreten trägst du maßgeblich zur Qualität unserer Arbeit bei.

Darüber hinaus beteiligst du dich aktiv an kollegial geführten Expertenteams, die sich aus Mitgliedern verschiedener Beratungsteams zusammensetzen. Gemeinsam übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung fachlicher Themen. So erweiterst du stetig dein Wissen durch den Austausch mit deinen Teammitgliedern.

Du verstehst die Herausforderungen der öffentlichen Verwaltung und möchtest dabei unterstützen diese nachhaltig zu lösen.

erfolg in der rolle heißt:

  • Du trägst Verantwortung für die Zielerreichung und Kundenzufriedenheit in deinem Projekt. Dazu gestaltest du eigenverantwortlich deinen Zeiteinsatz.
  • Du gibst und nimmst konstruktives Feedback und suchst aktiv nach Lernmöglichkeit.
  • Du entwickelst dein fachliches Profil entlang relevanter Kundenthemen in Einklang mit deinen persönlichen Zielen.
  • Du engagierst dich bei unserer Themenentwicklung und unterstützt deine Kollegen.

das zeichnet dich persönlich aus:

  • Du vertrittst unsere Werte durch professionelles Verhalten nach innen und außen.
  • Du arbeitest effizient und planst deinen Zeiteinsatz realistisch. Dadurch lieferst du qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse fristgerecht.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, verständlich und respektvoll. So bleibst du auch in Konfliktsituationen ruhig.
  • Du beherrschst die wichtigsten Methoden und Tools im Beratungsalltag. So bist du für jede Beratungssituation gerüstet.
  • Du entwickelst dein fachliches Profil aktiv weiter. Damit erhöhst du deinen Wert für unsere Kunden und das Unternehmen.

gehaltsspanne

50.000 bis 65.000 EUR

so arbeiten wir zusammen:

Wir sind ein junges Unternehmen und probieren gerne neue Dinge aus. Deine Ideen und individuellen Impulse sind bei uns willkommen. Du hast bei uns die Chance, unsere Zukunft selbst mitzugestalten.

Mit deinem Team arbeitest du täglich in unserem Virtual Office zusammen. Als Full-remote Unternehmen stellen wir dir Kollaborationssoftware und Meetingstrukturen bereit, mithilfe derer du auch von überall aus eng mit deinem Team zusammenwachsen wirst.

Das Führungsmodell im Unternehmen funktioniert ergebnisbasiert. Du übernimmst für deine Aufgaben die Verantwortung und kannst die Bearbeitung selbstständig gestalten.
Dazu gehört auch die Einteilung deiner Arbeitszeiten. Du kannst selbst am besten beurteilen, wann deine Arbeitszeit am besten eingesetzt ist. Kernarbeitszeiten haben wir nicht.

Führung wird bei uns als Dienstleistung gelebt. Du kannst jederzeit zu allen Anliegen deine Führungskraft hinzuziehen, um Unterstützung zu erhalten.

kontakt

Solltest du Fragen zu dieser Stelle haben, wende dich gerne an:
Jan.Hoffmann@public.consulting oder unter +49 151 645 03130

raw.description:
werde teil des teams

Arbeite mit den klügsten Köpfen unterschiedlicher Disziplinen der IT Security zusammen und sammle neben Deinem Studium vielfältige Praxiserfahrungen. Werde Teil eines unserer Teams, erlerne professionelle Skills und Methoden im Consulting Umfeld und entwickle Dich inhaltlich wie persönlich weiter!

was du bei uns bewegst

Du bist Teil unseres Teams von Studierenden, das über Standortgrenzen hinweg gemeinsam an Projekten arbeitet und unsere Pentester*innen und Security Consultants bei ihrer Arbeit unterstützt. Die Vielfalt an Tätigkeitsfeldern in unserem HeroLab ist groß. Folgende Aufzählung stellt daher nur eine Auswahl an Aufgaben dar:

  • Mitverantwortlichkeit für (Weiter-) Entwicklung von internen Tools und Leistungen
  • Aufbereitung und Erstellung von Schwachstellenbeschreibungen
  • Unterstützung bei Vorbereitung von Schulungen und Live Hacks für unsere Kunden
  • Erstellen von Challenges für das usd PentestLab, die zur internen Weiterbildung, für Vorlesungen und Veranstaltungen genutzt werden
Je nach persönlicher Entwicklung übernimmst Du mehr Verantwortung über Themengebiete und erhältst die Möglichkeit in Kundenprojekten mitzuwirken. Darüber hinaus steigst Du in höhere Kompetenzstufen auf, an die noch weitere Benefits und Gehälter geknüpft sind.

Du möchtest noch mehr über Pentesting als Beruf erfahren? Dann "Meet the Team".

was du mitbringst

In erster Linie hast Du richtig Lust, Dich mit Themen der IT Security zu beschäftigen und Dich bei uns im usd HeroLab einzubringen. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Du bist Student*in (all gender) der Fachrichtung Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik oder eines verwandten Studiengangs
  • Du besitzt ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis rund um das Thema Betriebssysteme und IT-Netzwerke
  • Du konntest bereits praktische Erfahrungen, bspw. durch Capture the Flag (CTFs) oder Hacking Events, sammeln
  • Du bist zuverlässig, zeigst Eigeninitiative und arbeitest gerne im Team
  • Du verfügst über eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit Dich in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

unsere benefits für dich

  • Starte bei uns optimal durch mit unserem "Students Hero Programm", Deinem Buddy und einem fachlichen Einarbeitungsplan
  • Kultur, die im Büro, zuhause und bei regelmäßigen Events gefeiert wird
  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen unserer Bonuskarte mit monatlichem Guthaben und der Bezuschussung einer Sportmitgliedschaft
  • Rundumversorgung im Alter durch eine Bezuschussung der Altersvorsorge und einer Risikolebensversicherung
  • Life-Work-Integration durch 30 Tage Urlaub, Vertrauensarbeitszeit, mobiles Arbeiten, individuelle Auszeit und Arbeitszeitmodelle, die Dir helfen, Studium und Arbeit optimal zu vereinbaren
  • Wir fördern DeineEntwicklungdurch Weiterbildung z.B. mit unserer CST Academy
  • Updates bei regelmäßigen Inhouse Workshops, Konferenzen, Circle Meetings und wöchentlichen Stand-ups
  • Attraktives Gehaltsmodell - Dein Einstiegsgehalt liegt bei 20 € brutto je Stunde
  • Option auf eine Festanstellung nach Deinem erfolgreichen Studienabschluss
  • Bring your Dog to work days ;)

über das usd herolab

Im usd HeroLab wird die technische Sicherheitskompetenz der usd gebündelt. Hier arbeiten unsere exzellent ausgebildeten Security Analyst*innen, Forensiker*innen und Entwickler*innen mit den Schwerpunkten Pentests, Code Reviews, digitale Forensik, Security Scans und Bug Bounty Services. Langjährige Erfahrung aus Projekten mit Unternehmen unterschiedlichster Größe und Branchen sowie die Durchführung von zehntausenden Security Scans und hunderten, jährlichen Pentests zeichnen uns als etablierte Sicherheitsexpert*innen in unserem Gebiet aus.

Start date: ASAP

About us

Sanctuary is building a wellness-centered residential community in the Texas Hill Country focused on healthy homes, regenerative land planning, nature, and intentional living.

Across 135 acres, we’re developing a modern village designed around clean air, clean water, thoughtful architecture, and meaningful human connection.

We’re not building traditional suburban housing. We’re creating a new way of living.

About the role

This role is all about execution.

We already have strong buyer interest. What we need is someone highly organized, commercially sharp, and relentless about follow-through.

Your primary responsibility is moving buyers from inquiry → discovery tour → active engagement with the sales team.

You’ll be the first real human connection many buyers have with Sanctuary. The way you communicate, follow up, and guide people through the process directly impacts whether they move forward or disappear.

This is not a passive “show homes on weekends” type of sales role.

We’re looking for someone who naturally thinks in:

  • follow-ups,

  • reminders,

  • pipeline management,

  • buyer psychology,

  • and consistent communication.

No lead left behind.

What you’ll own:

  • Buyer communication & follow-up: Manage inbound buyer interest across calls, texts, email, DMs, and Zoom. Maintain consistent communication and move conversations forward proactively.

  • Discovery tours & site visits: Coordinate and schedule tours, showings, and founder-led visits. Occasionally conduct on-site tours yourself when needed.

  • CRM & pipeline management: Keep HubSpot organized, updated, and actionable. Track every conversation, next step, and buyer interaction with strong attention to detail.

  • Buyer qualification & guidance: Confidently answer questions about the community, homes, process, timelines, and next steps while building trust with prospective buyers.

  • Sales process support: Support the CEO and sales team in converting a 700+ person interest list into serious buyers and signed contracts.

  • Buyer feedback & market insights: Identify recurring buyer questions, objections, and hesitations, and share insights with leadership to improve messaging and sales flow.

Who you are:

  • You have experience in high-touch sales, hospitality, luxury services, community sales, or another relationship-driven environment

  • You build trust quickly and communicate with confidence

  • You are extremely organized and naturally proactive

  • You follow up without needing reminders

  • You are commercially sharp and comfortable managing many ongoing conversations simultaneously

  • You thrive in fast-moving environments with high ownership

  • You genuinely care about wellness, design, sustainability, architecture, or intentional living

  • You have experience hosting tours or events

  • Strong understanding of high-net-worth buyers

Why you’ll love this role

  • You’ll get in early on something big - and see your impact daily

  • You’ll work alongside a small, driven team building something that doesn’t exist yet

  • You’ll learn fast, grow fast, and have a path toward leadership or specialization

  • You’ll help families make life-changing decisions - and feel good about what you’re selling

If you’re highly organized, great with people, and energized by turning interest into action - we’d love to hear from you.

We’re looking for anAccount Executive to build up our Swiss market from scratch - someone excited to build a market from the ground up, win the first customers, and shape how we grow locally while being at the front of a pretty exciting revolution in the legal space.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than €4 million and most recently closed a €2.9 million seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and leading angels. Pandektes already serves more than 350 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

As our first Account Executive focused on Switzerland, you’ll play a critical role in establishing and scaling the market.

  • You’ll be the one to acquire our first customers on the Swiss market, handle initial customer success and help scale our market in Switzerland.

  • Own the full sales cycle: you’ll prospect, qualify, present, and close. There’s no rigid script, but a strong playbook that you’ll learn and improve on.

  • You’ll be building client relationships with law firms, private companies, and public institutions. Your mission is to empower lawyers to fundamentally transform their research work with Pandektes.

What you’ll bring

  • Fluent in German and English (French is a plus)

  • Strong relationship building skills

raw.description:
About Us

Revalue is a carbon credit development platform focused on one of the planet’s most critical but complex challenges - seeing nature regenerated at a planetary scale.

Our mission is to design the most cutting-edge and trusted nature credits for our planet.

We are bringing together a world-class team - forestry experts, ecologists, applied AI scientists, software engineers, geospatial analysts, commercial specialists, economists, and more - to create the unique DNA required to reimagine nature credits.

About the role

As Carbon Finance Lead, you will be a key driver of our ability to finance and scale high-integrity climate and nature-based projects globally. You’ll serve as a strategic and execution-oriented partner to the leadership team, helping shape and deliver the project financing roadmap — from early-stage financing to securing investment for design and implementation stage carbon projects in our portfolio.

This role is for someone who blends financial sophistication with a practical, deal-making mindset and who can operate comfortably in an early-stage startup, high-growth environment. You’ll help unlock capital for project pipelines, build trusted relationships across climate finance, and partner with our internal teams to ensure our projects are investable, scalable, and aligned with evolving market expectations around integrity and impact.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Financing Leadership

  • Define and execute project financing strategy, aligned with the company’s mission, investor roadmap, and project pipeline.

  • Review and refine financing models, capital planning frameworks, and decision-making tools to support portfolio-scale growth.

  • Support leadership on forecasting, financing milestones, pipeline prioritisation, and financing-related KPIs.

Project Financing & Capital Structuring

  • Identify, structure, and support closing of financing deals across the project lifecycle, including early-stage and pilot project financing and milestone-based capital.

  • Design and package financing approaches that reduce risk for capital providers and accelerate project implementation.

  • Help develop investable project structures, including capital stack design, term sheets, and risk allocation.

Capital Partnerships & Investor Relationships

  • Build and cultivate strategic relationships with investors, financial institutions, family offices, DFIs, and funds active in climate and nature-based finance.

  • Lead engagement processes with capital partners, from initial outreach through diligence and final investment decision.

  • Serve as a credible external representative in climate finance settings, ensuring high trust and integrity in the way capital partnerships are built.

Investment Case Development

  • Work with internal teams to develop compelling investment narratives, financial models, and materials for project and platform financing.

  • Support data and assumptions required for due diligence, including delivery milestones, risk/return profiles, and implementation capacity.

  • Coordinate with our Assessment Team to ensure financing structures are aligned with on-the-ground delivery realities.

Who you are

Experienced Financing Leader

  • You bring significant experience in project finance, climate finance, structured finance, or investment advisory, with a track record of supporting or closing complex capital deals — ideally linked to climate, energy, nature-based solutions, or frontier markets.

Capital Markets & Climate Finance Fluency

  • You understand how institutional and private capital behaves, and you can navigate blended finance, catalytic capital, impact-linked instruments, and risk-adjusted project financing.

  • You’re comfortable shaping structures that satisfy both return expectations and impact requirements.

Strategic + Execution-Oriented

  • You can craft a long-term financing vision, but you also enjoy the day-to-day reality of progressing deals — refining materials, pushing diligence forward, and problem-solving through complexity.

Hands-On Deal Contributor

  • You don’t just advise from a distance — you proactively move financing conversations forward, engage partners directly, and contribute to deal structuring and closure.

Collaborative Builder

  • You are comfortable working across teams and can help establish repeatable financing playbooks, templates, and systems as the company scales.

Mission-Driven

  • You’re committed to climate impact and aligned with values around integrity, equity, and science-led solutions.

What we offer

  • Shared purpose, culture and values

  • A diverse team of colleagues, partners and clients based all around the world

  • Meaningful equity in an early-stage startup with a growing and trusted brand

  • Significant autonomy and influence at the leadership level

  • The opportunity to shape the future of nature-based climate finance

  • Performance-based variable compensation/commissions

  • Flexible working environment with a team deeply committed to impact

  • Generously enhanced, gender-neutral parental leave policy

  • Wellbeing support, including company-funded access to therapy

raw.description:
🧠 About Legion Health

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce 25K+ total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Job Type: Full-Time

  • Role Type: Growth / Sales / Provider Partnerships

  • Ideal Experience Level: 7+ years

  • Location: Remote, with frequent in-market travel. San Francisco or Texas home base is not required, but a nice bonus.

  • US Visa Sponsorship: Yes

🚀 The Opportunity

Legion is hiring a Head of Provider Partnerships to build one of the company’s most important growth engines: trusted referral relationships with primary care providers and other clinical partners who need a fast, high-quality psychiatry partner for their patients.

This is a founding commercial leadership role. You will design the playbook, personally open priority markets, win high-value referral partners, build the operating system for provider growth, and eventually hire and lead a national provider partnerships team. The right person has the grit of a top physician liaison, the strategic judgment of a healthcare BD leader, and the urgency to turn clinical trust into measurable patient access.

✅ Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • Build Legion’s provider referral engine from 0 to 1, then 1 to N.

  • Identify, prioritize, and win high-potential referral sources, including PCPs, pediatricians, OB/GYNs, therapists, urgent care clinics, health-system care teams, community clinics, and other behavioral health organizations.

  • Create territory and market launch plans: account targeting, outreach cadence, field visits, presentations, lunch-and-learns, events, and provider education.

  • Own referral growth metrics, including new referring accounts, active referral partners, monthly referral volume, referral-to-scheduled conversion, completed visits, partner retention, and provider satisfaction.

  • Build relationships with physicians, practice administrators, office managers, MAs, referral coordinators, care managers, and clinical leaders.

  • Make Legion easy to refer to by diagnosing and removing friction across eligibility, scheduling, documentation, insurance coverage, patient handoff, and follow-up communication.

  • Partner with clinical operations, product, marketing, intake, credentialing, and data teams to improve the referral experience end-to-end.

  • Build repeatable systems: CRM hygiene, account scoring, partner collateral, market dashboards, weekly reporting, referral attribution, and field-team training.

  • Collect market feedback from providers and turn it into better messaging, workflows, product improvements, and clinical operations.

  • Hire, coach, and manage Provider Partnerships Managers / Physician Liaisons as the channel scales.

🏆 You’ll Be Successful If You…

  • Build a repeatable provider-referral motion that can scale beyond founder-led sales.

  • Generate meaningful referral volume from high-quality clinical partners, not one-off low-intent sources.

  • Prove Legion can win trust in competitive local markets against incumbent psychiatry groups, hospital systems, therapy networks, and behavioral health startups.

  • Create a clean operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, account plans, referral dashboards, partner feedback loops, and clear attribution.

  • Improve the full funnel from provider referral to patient scheduled to completed visit.

  • Make providers love referring to Legion because access is fast, care is high-quality, and the handoff is easy.

  • Build a field team that is accountable, resilient, clinically credible, and relentlessly useful to provider offices.

🧰 Ideal Background and Skills

  • 7+ years in healthcare business development, provider partnerships, physician liaison, clinical outreach, territory sales, or referral-growth roles.

  • Strong preference for psychiatry, behavioral health, primary care, specialty care, outpatient imaging, physical therapy, home health, hospice, specialty pharmacy, GI, dermatology, women’s health, or other referral-driven care models.

  • Proven track record of growing referral volume through direct provider relationships.

  • Experience owning a market, region, or territory with concrete activity and performance metrics.

  • Strong field-sales instincts: high activity, crisp follow-up, account prioritization, route planning, and comfort hearing “no.”

  • Ability to build trust across physicians, office staff, administrators, referral coordinators, and executive stakeholders.

  • Deep understanding of healthcare workflows: referrals, intake, scheduling, EHRs, fax, patient engagement, insurance coverage, and clinical handoffs.

  • Comfortable using CRM, spreadsheets, dashboards, and referral data to manage performance.

  • High judgment around compliance, HIPAA, patient privacy, and ethical referral practices.

  • Low ego, high urgency, strong ownership. You do not need a perfect system to start producing results.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $150,000 – $210,000, based on experience

  • Performance Bonus: Meaningful variable compensation tied to referral growth and market launches

  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, travel reimbursement, provider engagement budget

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

  • Work Hours: Flexible

  • Work Setup: Remote with frequent in-market travel

  • Impact: Work on something that will change health care forever.

  • Autonomy and Learning: Ownership over your metrics with the freedom to set priorities, shape processes, and drive outcomes end-to-end.

  • Growth Opportunities: As we scale, we envision our top performers from our founding team stepping into expanded roles and joining our executive leadership team.

📝 How to Apply and Hiring Process

  • Apply here:https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/legionhealth/a3cc3ecb-0e5a-4b4b-a4cd-1d6684ef1daf/application

  • Overview of our hiring process:

    1. Resume + Application Screen

    2. Founder Interview(s)

    3. Advisor Interview(s)

    4. Professional Reference Checks

  • Estimated time-to-hire: 2 weeks

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Hiring manager: Arthur MacWaters

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. raw.title: Field Marketing Manager (Eastern Time Zone) - Remote, USA
raw.excerpt: TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better.
raw.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

TeamViewer is seeking a highly organized, driven, and customer-focused Field Marketing Manager to join our Americas Marketing team.

Reporting to the Head of Americas Field & Partner Marketing, you will help develop and execute marketing programs designed to generate pipeline, accelerate opportunities, engage customers, and support strategic partnerships across North America.

This is an excellent opportunity for a field marketer who is ready to take ownership of regional programs, partner closely with sales teams, and drive measurable business impact across North America.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan and execute regional marketing programs that drive pipeline growth and customer engagement.

  • Own a portfolio of field marketing events and programs from concept through execution, including budgeting, attendee recruitment, logistics, and post-event follow-up.

  • Support executive roundtables, customer events, partner programs, trade shows, hospitality experiences, webinars, and targeted account-based marketing initiatives.

  • Partner closely with sales teams to identify target accounts, drive attendance, and maximize business impact.

  • Collaborate with channel, alliance, digital marketing, marketing operations, and SDR teams to deliver successful programs.

  • Track program performance and provide insights and recommendations for future optimization.

Requirements:

  • 3–6 years of experience in B2B marketing, field marketing, event marketing, demand generation, partner marketing, or marketing operations.

  • Experience executing customer events, executive engagement programs, webinars, trade shows, or partner marketing initiatives.

  • Experience executing account-based marketing (ABM), executive engagement programs, and targeted 1:1 or 1: Few marketing initiatives.

  • Experience partnering with sales organizations to drive pipeline creation, opportunity acceleration, and customer expansion.

  • Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills.

  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and project management tools.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30–40% throughout North America.

  • Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to support customer-facing events and programs.

What we offer:

  • Work location is Remote, USA. (Must be based in the Eastern Time Zone within the United States)

  • Competitive compensation including stock-based options

  • Flexible PTO and paid holidays

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Comprehensive Health insurance package including 100% employer-paid medical coverage

  • Up to 12 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability, 100% employer-paid

  • Quarterly teambuilding events, leadership luncheons, and companywide “All Hands” meetings

  • Open door policy and casual dress code

  • We celebrate diversity as one of our core values. Join c-a-r-e and lead change initiatives together with us!

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States. Please understand TeamViewer is unable to provide sponsorship for employment or work authorization now or in the future.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

description: Localization Project Manager (Remote)We are looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager to support one of our top clients in the digital space.

raw.title: Localization Project Manager
raw.excerpt: Localization Project Manager (Remote)We are looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager to support one of our top clients in the digital space.
raw.description:
Localization Project Manager (Remote)

We are looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager to support one of our top clients in the digital space. In a fully remote, 6-month engagement starting in July. The role requires at least 20 hours per week, with the possibility of extending to 40 hours depending on project scope. The working schedule must include overlap with US Eastern Time.

This is a hands-on operational role focused on content localization pipeline management, CMS handling, and coordination of translation workflows across multiple tools and platforms.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate localization content workflows across multiple systems and sources
  • Load and maintain content in Crowdin from platforms such as GitHub, Iterable, Google Slides, and Webflow
  • Ensure proper structuring, consistency, and readiness of content for localization
  • Route and send content from Crowdin to translation vendors
  • Monitor project status, timelines, and delivery quality across localization pipelines
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and localization teams to ensure smooth end-to-end delivery
  • Troubleshoot content or integration issues between CMS platforms and localization tools
  • Support continuous improvement of localization processes and automation workflows

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Localization Project Management or Localization Operations
  • Hands-on experience with localization workflows and CMS tools (Crowdin experience is a strong plus; any CMS experience is acceptable)
  • Proven ability to manage structured content workflows and multi-source content ingestion
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to handle multiple concurrent content streams
  • Experience working with distributed teams and remote collaboration tools
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, production-oriented environment with overlapping time zones (US Eastern Time required overlap)
  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating or working with tools like GitHub, Iterable, Webflow, or similar content systems
  • Familiarity with localization automation and connector-based workflows
  • Experience working with translation vendors or TMS platforms (e.g., Translated, Smartling, Phrase)

Work setup

  • Fully remote
  • 6-month contract starting in July
  • 20–40 hours per week
  • Required overlap with US Eastern Time working hours

Privacy Policy

raw.title: International Remote High Ticket Sales Closer
raw.excerpt: Job descriptionIn our world, “high ticket” is anything with a price point of about $10k or above.
raw.description:
Job description

In our world, “high ticket” is anything with a price point of about $10k or above. We firmly believe that some of the most talented sales professionals in the world are underpaid because they’re in the wrong vehicle selling the wrong product. We take pride in seeking out top talent, developing them further into highly trained closers, and enabling them to reach new levels of earning potential through high ticket sales with WFS Group. Put simply, there are a handful of things a sales role needs to provide for you to maximize earning potential: high quality leads, high deal velocity, high average sales price, short sales cycle, a strong commission structure, and solid systems & training to support you; we provide all of that. If your current position is missing any one of those key elements, you owe it to yourself to apply and find out for yourself.

Competitive Commission Structure & Earning Potential!

Selling Life Changing Products!

Inbound Leads from Word Class Marketing!

A Snapshot of WFS Group:

WFS Group is a fast paced, high performance sales agency that provides what is referred to as “done for you sales” services to our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales! Put simply, our clients outsource their sales department to us and we sell their services/packages to help them scale faster than ever before while changing as many people’s lives as possible. The main verticals we service are in the online, digital marketing based community with companies that have educational programs that teach high paying skill sets which is referred to as “alternative education.” We sell a range of transformative programs and packages including everything from business consulting programs, to programs that teach people how to invest in real estate, learn mergers and acquisitions and many many more. The world is changing and so is the education space with college application and admission rates down significantly. Bespoke alternative education is a multi billion dollar a year industry and growing, and you can be a part of the gold rush. We believe people’s dream lives are just on the other side of receiving the right information- we’re responsible for getting that to them.

Position Overview:

We’re looking for top performing sales professionals that are grateful to wake up to a full calendar of leads and are addicted to chasing the rush of the deal! This role is a closer position which will primarily consist of taking inbound scheduled sales calls generated from our marketing efforts, taking the leads through the WFS proprietary selling framework, managing your pipeline, and maximizing revenue by generating sales. Although this role is NOT an outbound role, we are NOT looking for lazy closers. We want hungry, ambitious, and grateful closers that aren’t afraid to dial additional opportunities in between scheduled calls. If you are a self-motivated and growth-driven individual, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity.

Why High Ticket Closers LOVE WFS Group:

  • Fully location independent (remote position)

  • Set your own hours, manage your own calendar

  • $10-15k average deal value

  • 10-14 day average sales cycle

  • Consistent inbound lead flow

  • Huge earning potential for those that are willing to hustle

  • Word class sales training & weekly team coaching

  • High Performance Culture (A players only)

  • Offers that change our customers lives!!

Responsibilities:

  • Consistently increase product knowledge by consuming the content in the sales training center.

  • Participate in daily sales syncs via zoom to discuss sales initiatives, study sales call game tape, and strategize around the pipeline.

  • Follow the WFS proprietary selling framework to take leads through the sales process (training provided).

  • Engage in deep question led discovery dialogue to identity challenges, pain points, and gaps that create the need, desire, & urgency for WFS products and services.

  • Build and maintain relationships with leads, using a consultative sales approach to understand their goals, objectives, and dominant buying motives.

  • Utilize WFS sales material & tools to deliver persuasive sales presentations via zoom that speak to core desires, highlighting the key benefits and value of WFS products and services.

  • Achieve or exceed sales quotas and targets, consistently meeting or exceeding sales performance expectations.

  • Adhere to CRM best practices to track and manage sales activities, including lead management, follow-up, and accurate forecasting.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless and successful sales process.

  • Display WFS core values at all times to contribute to a high performance culture.

Requirements:

  • 2 years of previous experience in high ticket sales or consultative sales process, with a proven track record of closing deals and driving revenue.

  • Effective communication and presentation skills.

  • Self-starter with a strong drive for success.

  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

  • Excellent people skills with the ability to create rapport.

  • Experience and working knowledge of CRM systems.

You SHOULD apply if:

  • KNOW you were born to be a top producer/top earner

  • You have extensive experience in phone/zoom sales

  • You’re hungry with tenacity and not a spoiled lazy closer

  • Bring energy and enthusiasm to every room you’re in

  • You’re a strategic individual and thoroughly enjoy the sales process

  • You’re extremely coachable and disciplined

  • You can learn and adapt quickly in a fast paced sales environment

  • You have advanced sales experience

  • You consider yourself to be of the most elite sales professionals out

You should NOT apply if:

  • Aren’t all of the things listed above

  • Can’t commit to learning our systems, processes, and offer

  • Don’t work well in a structured team setting with other top performers

  • Don’t have amazing communication skills

  • Are a one trick pony and not a dynamic individual

  • Get stressed out in fast paced operations

  • NEED results overnight

  • Don’t have legit sales experience

  • Are lying about your experience

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $90,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

This position is an Independent Contractor Role - 1099

Flexible Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday

  • Must work US Based Time Zone

Work Location: Remote

Compensation Range: $90K - $300K

raw.excerpt: was wir suchen Die #1 Plattform für NeukundenJedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir.
raw.description:
was wir suchen

Die #1 Plattform für Neukunden

Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.

Um unsere Systeme, Abläufe und Prozesse auf das nächste Level zu bringen und als Firma so effizient wie möglich zu arbeiten, suchen wir dich als SeniorOperations Manager (m/w/d) – eine erfahrene, umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit mit strategischem Blick und Hands-on-Mentalität.

das sind deine aufgaben

  • Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle operativen Themen und bereichsübergreifenden Projekte, du erkennst, wo Handlungsbedarf besteht, und sorgst eigenständig für Umsetzung und Fortschritt.
  • Du verantwortest die Verwaltung, Weiterentwicklung und Integration unserer Tools & Schnittstellen (z. B. HubSpot, Notion, Zapier, Aircall, Slack) und stellst sicher, dass Prozesse nahtlos miteinander verknüpft sind.
  • Du steuerst eigenständig das operative Projektmanagement von bereichsübergreifenden Initiativen, von Priorisierung und Planung über Koordination mit Teams bis hin zu Umsetzung, Erfolgsmessung und kontinuierlicher Optimierung.
  • Du arbeitest datengetrieben: Du analysierst Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung ab.
  • Du unterstützt und leitest strategische Sonderprojekte, insbesondere im Bereich Automatisierung und künstliche Intelligenz, beispielsweise bei KI-basierten Workflows, internen KI-Agenten oder der Optimierung von Systemintegrationen.

das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Operations- oder Projektmanagement, idealerweise in einem Scale-up oder Start-up Umfeld, und bringst ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative mit.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung, erkennst Themen selbstständig und bringst Projekte auch unter Zeitdruck erfolgreich zum Abschluss.
  • Du findest pragmatische, effiziente Lösungen und denkst prozessorientiert, mit einem klaren Fokus auf Umsetzung und Wirkung.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in Stakeholder-Management, arbeitest strukturiert und kannst Prioritäten klar setzen und verfolgen.
  • Du bist technikaffin, arbeitest dich schnell und neugierig in neue Tools ein und nutzt Daten und KPIs als Grundlage für fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du interessierst dich für Automatisierung und KI und hast idealerweise bereits mit Tools wie Zapier, Make, OpenAI oder Claude gearbeitet.
  • Du denkst in Systemen, arbeitest strukturiert und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für effiziente, skalierbare Workflows und smarte Prozesse.

das bieten wir dir

  • Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld und die Möglichkeit, zusammen “The Lead Company” zu bauen
  • Ein riesiger Markt und viele interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, da wir das größte Problem unserer Partner lösen: Wir automatisieren die Neukundengewinnung
  • Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (arbeite je nach Position entweder remote oder aus unserem Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt – auch Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist nach Absprache möglich)
  • 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und jederzeit die Möglichkeit, unbezahlt Urlaub zu nehmen
  • Wir bezuschussen deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead-Rente”)
  • Jedes Jahr großartige Events (Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier)
  • Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – um möglichst produktiv zu sein, arbeiten wir mit modernsten Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum
  • Wir bezuschussen dein Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E-Gym Wellpass)
  • Schnelle Entscheidungen, da wir 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und somit nicht von Investoren abhängig sind
  • Eine offene Feedback-Kultur und internes Führungskräfte-Training

raw.description:
Job description

A Snapshot of WFS Group:

WFS Group is a fast paced, high performance sales agency that provides what is referred to as “done for you sales” services to our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales 🤪Put simply, our clients outsource their sales department to us and we sell their services/packages to help them scale faster than ever before while changing as many people’s lives as possible. The main verticals we service are in the online, digital marketing based community with companies that have educational programs that teach high paying skill sets which is referred to as “alternative education.” We sell a range of transformative programs and packages including everything from business consulting programs, to programs that teach people how to invest in real estate, learn mergers and acquisitions and many many more. The world is changing and so is the education space with college application and admission rates down significantly. Bespoke alternative education is a multi billion dollar a year industry and growing, and you can be a part of the gold rush. We believe people’s dream lives are just on the other side of receiving the right information- we’re responsible for getting that to them.

Competitive Comp Structure & Earning Potential!

Selling Life Changing Products!

Managing Top Performing Fully Remote Sales Teams!

Position Overview:

As an outsourced sales company, one of the main ways we differentiate ourselves is by positioning that we are not just “done for you sales” but rather “done for you sales operations.” The distinction is that while competitors just simply provide the sales talent, we bring a more comprehensive solution that includes sales management and all of our scaling systems. Needless to say, the Sales Director is a critical role in our sales management infrastructure, and in the overall solution we provide to our clients.. The way our management structure is designed is that each Sales Director oversees a few key accounts depending on the size, sales volume, and overall workload. This dynamic role varies in day to day responsibilities based on the specific demands of the assigned accounts and the critical areas of focus, but includes overseeing pipeline management, consistently conducting call reviews, evaluating rep performance, ensuring CRM data & reporting accuracy to make projections, identify training & rep development opportunities, and consistently suggesting operational improvements to maximize sales and find new levels of untapped potential for the prospective accounts.

You SHOULD apply to this role if:

  • You have experience managing sales teams in the high ticket alternative education space (Required)

  • You have extensive experience working in lead generation based businesses

  • You are great at managing the qualitative side of sales (culture, training, rep development) AND quantitative side of sales (data, sales metrics, performance KPIs, and quotas)

  • You have extensive experience driving efficiency through tech stack & a process to minimize revenue leakage

  • You understand the importance of sales enablement & can help ideate & give input on sales material

  • You know how to lead and motivate high intensity sales teams

  • Sales tech and spreadsheets don't stress you out

  • You understand the importance of establishing a feedback loop with marketing

  • You’ve had challenges finding your current role exciting

  • You’re stuck in a mundane repeatable process working in a static environment

  • You believe in the power of data and use it to make informed decisions

  • You enjoy fast paced energetic environments

  • You LOVE learning new things & having fun at the same time

You SHOULD NOT apply to this role if:

  • You are NOT an independent thinker

  • You don’t have real experience managing high ticket sales teams through data & forecasts

  • You haven’t managed a sales team with at least 5 or more sales reps

  • If you think it would be lame to help sales teams grow lightening fast

  • If you can’t learn CRM systems and manage through reports

  • You are absolutely clueless when it comes to understanding lead generation

  • You get frustrated easily instead of looking at challenges as a puzzle to solve

  • You are NOT teachable and do NOT seek personal development

  • You eat your pizza with ranch (may be flexible on this one)

Major Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Evaluates lead flow ratios and rep capacity on a daily basis

  • Works closely with marketing teams on lead flow initiatives to ensure profitable return on ad spend for our accounts

  • Tracks and monitors sales reps’ pipelines to ensure best lead management practices

  • Consistently managing out of the CRM to find and prevent missed opportunities

  • Run all daily sales syncs

  • Create sales trainings for sales training center (STC)

  • Enforce adherence to sales process SOPs

  • Reviews and analyzes calls recordings and creates call reviews for training purposes

  • Helps strategize deals with sales reps to increase sales

  • Maintains projections and manages sales quotas

  • Track and evaluate sales rep performance to make data driven decisions

  • Exemplify the WFS core values & display rep spotlights

  • Review all end of day reports from sales reps

  • Attend all account status meetings

  • Study account offers/product knowledge (training center resident expert)

  • Communicate staffing needs based on capacity & performance

  • Assist the CSO & recruiting team in interviewing and hiring new sales reps

  • Onboarding, training, and ramping new sales reps

  • Identify sales enablement assets & process improvements

  • Work with the sales integrators on all data, reporting, & CRM accuracy

  • Communicate to sales integrator all tech related tasks

  • Takes complete revenue ownership

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $120,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Compensation package:

  • Bonus opportunities

  • Commission pay

  • Uncapped commission

Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday

Work Location: Remote

Compensation Range: $120K - $250K

About Playlink

We are an innovative iGaming company offering a comprehensive suite of crypto-focused products, including sportsbook and casino experiences. By combining cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of the crypto space, we aim to revolutionise the betting and gaming experience for a global audience.

Our mission is to create the most effortless and accessible betting and gaming entertainment experience, delivering innovation and personalisation at every touchpoint.

Our vision is to become a leading player in the betting industry by combining seamless user experiences with groundbreaking personalisation and community-driven engagement.

Whether it’s through competitive sportsbook offerings or immersive casino gameplay, we are dedicated to creating a unique and engaging platform. Join us in shaping the future of crypto iGaming.

The Company

We are an innovative, fast-growing, remote-first global startup operating at the intersection of iGaming, casino, and crypto. Our team of 50 is dotted across the globe, working asynchronously to build the future of our industry.

As an early-stage startup, we operate with agility and high momentum. The foundational People processes are established and fully operational — we are now seeking someone to maintain and manage these structures, whilst proactively identifying and designing opportunities for continuous optimisation.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced People Lead to join us on a 6-month fixed-term contract (with potential for extension) for maternity leave cover.

This is a standalone HR position, meaning you will have full ownership of our People function. You won’t just be maintaining the current operations — you will be leading our remote culture, managing our global operations and compliance, and act as a trusted partner to our Founders. We need someone who deeply understands the founder mentality, can navigate wearing multiple hats with ease, and excels at operating cross-functionally in a lean, rapid startup environment.

Responsibilities

  • Standalone Function Management - run the day-to-day People operations fully autonomously, serving as the sole point of contact for our global workforce.

  • End-to-End Employee Lifecycle - partner closely with managers to run the full employee lifecycle — including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, performance management, development, employee relations, organisational design, reward / remuneration, and policy writing and implementation.

  • Global Payroll & EOR Management - manage our global workforce operations utilising Deel, ensuring seamless onboarding, offboarding, regulatory compliance, and monthly contractor/EOR management.

  • People Operations & Systems - maintain and elevate our internal tech stack. Design and implement efficient remote workflows utilising platforms such as Notion, Miro, and Slack, establishing automated integrations to minimise manual overhead.

  • Data Analysis - analyse HR data and metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and risks — translating these insights into clear actionable recommendations.

  • Process Maintenance & Innovation - ensure the continuity of existing foundational People processes while proactively introducing scalable, sophisticated methodologies to enhance corporate culture, operational efficiency, and employee engagement.

  • Founder Partnership - partner closely with the founders to align People initiatives with broader commercial objectives, serving as a strategic sounding board within a high-growth startup environment.

  • Employee Relations & Engagement - support our global team across multiple timezones, managing employee lifecycle events, and navigating multiple communication styles effectively.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Startup Experience - a proven track record within early-stage or scaling startups. Candidates must demonstrate resourcefulness, resilience, and the ability to establish order in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

  • Standalone Capability - must be comfortable working as a team of one.

  • Remote Management - experience working remotely and managing People operations for a global workforce.

  • Deel & EOR Experience - must have practical, hands-on experience managing global teams and compliance. Experience and knowledge of working with Deel is required.

  • Systems & Operations - proficiency in HR tech. Experience building or restructuring workspaces in Notion, mapping workflows and talent mapping in Miro, and deploying Slack integrations / automations is highly valued.

  • Stakeholder Management - Exceptional emotional intelligence and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with founders.

Must be available to start in July/August 2026 — please ensure alignment with this timeline ahead of applying.

About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Tax Director to lead global tax compliance, planning, and advisory matters for individuals, trusts, investment entities, and privately held businesses. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong project management skills, and the ability to provide proactive, high-touch tax guidance across complex structures, cross border, and multigenerational planning considerations.

This individual will serve as a key partner to Finance and executive leadership, advising on the tax implications of investments, transactions, and broader financial activities from an individual and business perspective.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise across U.S. and international tax, strong operational leadership, and the ability to navigate evolving regulatory landscapes while building scalable, best-in-class tax processes.

Your Impact
Tax Strategy & Planning

  • Lead tax planning and strategy across U.S. federal, state, and international jurisdictions, covering both individual and entity-level matters

  • Provide hands-on oversight of individual tax matters, including income, capital gains, and cross-border considerations

  • Advise on residency and domicile planning, including multi-jurisdictional considerations (U.S. and international jurisdictions)

  • Support tax-efficient structuring of investments, liquidity events, and distributions across a range of asset classes

  • Provide tax input on private equity, venture, real estate, and alternative investments at both the investor and entity level

  • Structure and oversee partnerships, trusts, holding companies, and special purpose vehicles to support broader tax objectives

  • Evaluate tax positions to ensure technical defensibility and alignment with long-term strategy

  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and proactively adapt planning strategies

  • Lead preparation, review, and oversight of complex federal, state & local, and foreign tax compliance matters for individuals, trusts, partnerships, LLCs, and related entities


International Tax

  • Advise on cross-border tax planning for both individuals and entities, including coordination across multiple jurisdictions

  • Support structuring and planning for the U.S. and involving tax-efficient jurisdictions and relevant international locations

  • Provide guidance on international reporting, foreign tax credits, and multi-jurisdictional compliance considerations

  • Coordinate with local advisors to ensure alignment across global tax positions


Controls & Compliance

  • Oversee tax compliance across individual, partnership, and corporate structures, including income tax and information reporting

  • Ensure high-quality, audit-ready documentation and strong internal controls across all activities

  • Partner with Accounting on tax reporting and provision considerations where applicable

  • Maintain compliance with applicable regulatory and governance frameworks


Vendor & Advisor Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external tax advisors, private banking partners, auditors, and legal counsel

  • Provide direction and oversight to ensure alignment with internal strategy and timely execution

  • Evaluate external recommendations and drive decision-making across competing viewpoints

  • Coordinate across multiple stakeholders to ensure seamless execution

  • Actively manage and negotiate fees with external service providers to ensure competitive pricing, efficiency and high-quality services


Operational Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing tax function, including processes, systems, and external partnerships

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Finance, Legal, Treasury, and other stakeholders

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded initiatives from planning through execution

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on both individual and entity-level tax matters

  • Support a wide range of ad hoc tax and financial matters in a fast-paced environment


Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive tax experience in a Big Four, law firm, private client, or similarly complex environment

  • CPA, JD, or Master’s in Taxation (or equivalent advanced degree)

  • Proven experience advising on individual and entity-level tax planning, including work with private clients or private banking relationships

  • Experience with partnerships, trusts, and investment structures

  • Experience with cross-border tax planning for both individuals and entities

  • Ability to operate both strategically and hands-on across a broad range of tax matters

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with senior stakeholders and operate with a high degree of ownership and judgment

  • Strong knowledge of estate, gift, and fiduciary income tax matters

  • Ability to operate independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive financial information with discretion and professionalism

  • Strong technical individualtax knowledge of U.S. federal, state, and international tax


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting private clients, private banking relationships, or investment platforms

  • Experience with European or other international tax frameworks

  • Exposure to alternative investments and complex ownership structures

  • Experience in dynamic, high-growth, or entrepreneurial environments
